Flight accompanying fleeing car and source shining/glowing red eyes, no invented electricity disruption visuals or bridge curse.
Point Pleasant road/TNT former munitions area, night with car headlights; no cinematic/game Mothman design.

selection_reason: Proposed selected: unmistakable headless/no-neck silhouette with chest eyes most distinct from ordinary bird or popular moth-man design.

visual_review.notes: Native viewed: dark man-shaped creature has broad continuous shoulder contour WITHOUT separate head or obvious neck, two bright red eyes embedded in upper torso; two humanlike arms, two trailing legs and two avian wings held rigid across square as it glides alongside car window. No nose/beak/mouth, antennae, owl head, moth wings or superhero costume. Close chest eyes and low car window perspective create strong threat; no text/gore or invented technology effects.
limitations: Exact dark body/feather texture, hand detail and dark wing coloration are editorial; c31/c32 do not specify wing color.
Wing outer ends outside close square; fixed wing posture and headless shoulder contour clear.
Six-foot report interpreted at close car-window perspective, not literal giant-size claim; roadside/rain/car detail editorial.
